name: baiduhotsearch
description: Real-time Baidu hot-search dashboard (热搜 · 小说 · 电影 · 电视剧) built with Streamlit — one-click refresh with cache & sample-data fallback.

paragraphs: Domestic buzz · World news · Tech trends — 16 live sources aggregated on one page
Formerly "Baidu Hot Search" — a single-board dashboard, now a multi-source trending radar

One board shows you one platform's view — and Baidu's skews entertainment. This project aggregates domestic life trends (Weibo / Zhihu / Douyin / Toutiao / Baidu / Bilibili / Tieba / Tencent News / The Paper), world news in Chinese (Google News / NYT Chinese) and tech circles (Hacker News / GitHub Trending / V2EX / Juejin / Product Hunt) onto a single page, then algorithmically clusters topics that multiple sources are reporting at the same time — when several independent boards hit the same story, that's the news that actually matters.
features: 🌐 Cross-source board (flagship): title-similarity clustering merges entries about the same event from ≥2 sources, ranked by hit count (ties by a unified composite heat) — tell "platform noise" from "global news" at a…
🗂️ Three category views: 🇨🇳 Domestic / 🌍 World / 💻 Tech — single source, or a "mixed stream" that interleaves all sources by rank
🆕 New / time-on-board badges: SQLite snapshots mark first-seen topics and how long an entry has been trending
🛡️ Three-tier fallback, never blank: live data → 15-min cached snapshot (with age notice) → sample data
🩺 Source diagnostics panel: probes all 16 sources in parallel, reporting availability, item count and latency

requirements.text: 60s API instance: built-in official + community instances with automatic failover; public instances are rate-limited, so you can point to your self-hosted instance (Docker / Node, one-click to Vercel / Zeabur)
Weibo Cookie: paste it once (login weibo.com → F12 → copy the SUB=... from any request header) to go direct to Weibo's official API — works on cloud deploys too; otherwise via 60s API
Self-host with a persistent volume to keep it long-term (7 days retained by default).
